scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @spms/shared run build && pnpm --parallel --filter @spms/shared --filter @spms/api --filter @spms/web run dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @spms/shared run build && pnpm --filter @spms/api run build && pnpm --filter @spms/web run build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @spms/shared run build && pnpm --filter @spms/shared --filter @spms/api run test
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @spms/shared run build && pnpm --filter @spms/api run test:e2e
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @spms/shared run build && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.db:seed:demo: pnpm --filter @spms/shared run build && pnpm --filter @spms/api run db:seed:demo
